title: Score explanation
description: Version 1.0. Why a candidate got their score, returned by the scorer with every score and stored in scores.component_breakdown. Every text comes from a fixed template, and every value from the redacted CV: no name, contact detail or date. Every object is closed: a new field needs a new explanation_version. Rules for changing it: docs/ml/score-explanation.md.

explanation_version.description: Version of this schema the explanation was written with.

model_version.description: The scorer that produced the explanation, the same as scores.model_version.

band.description: strong, moderate or weak, from the thresholds in weights.yaml.

summary.description: Band, required skills and experience, in two or three sentences.

components.description: The five parts of the score, always in this order: skill_overlap, embedding_similarity, experience_fit, title_similarity, text_similarity.

matched_skills.description: Job skills the candidate has: required ones first, then nice-to-have ones, each in the job's order.

missing_skills.description: Job skills the candidate lacks, as the job writes them.

advisory_note.description: Says that the score is advisory and can be wrong (US-09). Show it with the score.

score.description: 0 to 100, or null when it could not be computed. Null never means 0.

weight.description: Share of the total actually applied, 0 to 1. 0 when score is null: its share is spread over the other components.

contribution.description: Points this component added to the total: score times weight. The contributions add up to the total, give or take rounding.

statement.description: One or two sentences from the templates.

cv_phrase.description: As the CV writes it, e.g. "Postgres" for the job's "PostgreSQL".

status.description: meets: has at least the minimum. below: has fewer years. not_required: the job gives no minimum, or 0. unknown: the CV gives no total years. Only meets and below are scored.

candidate_years.description: Total years of experience from the CV, or null when it gives none.

required_years.description: The job's minimum, or null when it gives none.
